schema.description: JSON schema for SIL KIT Registry configuration files.

SchemaVersion.description: Version of the schema used to validate this document

Description.description: Free text field allowing a user to describe the configuration file in their own words. The contents of this field are not parsed or used internally.

ListenUri.description: The configured registry instance will listen on this address for incoming connections. Optional; This field overrides the -u, and --listen-uri command line parameters.

DashboardUri.description: The configured registry instance will send data to this address to show it on the dashboard. Optional; This field overrides the -d, and --dashboard-uri command line parameters.

description:
The current SIL Kit Registry configuration for our development environment references the schema file ./RegistryConfiguration.schema.json and uses schema version 1. It is described as “Configuration for SIL Kit Registry in development environment.” The registry will listen for incoming SIL Kit connections on silkit://0.0.0.0:8501, and it will forward dashboard data to http://localhost:8082.  

Logging is set to flush at the **Info** level. Two logging sinks are defined: a file sink that records messages at the **Debug** level to files named registry_log_%y-%m-%dT%h-%m-%s.txt, and a standard‑output sink that outputs messages at the **Info** level.
